attempts.text:
**The spine is a single gene.** Column 0, `chaB`, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls, and named in 98% with 0.10 bits. Then the graph opens: columns 1 to 79 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 81% of calls.

**The first forks carry a parallel path.** Columns 5 to 20 also carry a second branch of 16 families, `narX` to `ychE`, persistent, at 11% of chromosomes, [[nitrate reduction and sulfur relay]]. Columns 22 to 27 carry a second branch of 6 families, `oppA` to `oppF` among them, shell, at 29 to 30%, [[oligopeptide transport]]. Columns 28 to 36 carry a second branch of 9 families, `cls` to `ompW`, persistent, at 11%.

**The middle is variable.** Columns 37 to 50, in 51 to 88% of chromosomes, hold `umuD` to `ymgG`, [[translesion DNA repair and cell division]]. Columns 55 to 71, in 8 to 78% of chromosomes, hold `ymgA` to `phoQ`, [[two-component regulation and nucleotide metabolism]]. Columns 73 to 78, in 30 to 57% of chromosomes, hold `pepT` to `ymfA`, [[spermidine and putrescine transport]].

**The model hesitates most at the forks.** Column 54, `ariR`, is the most hesitant at 1.10 bits, in a region of plasticity in 70% of calls; column 53, `ymgC`, 1.09 bits; column 52, `pdeG`, 1.07 bits. The fewest named is column 53, 78%. Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside, 1.24 against 0.25 bits, and names fewer genes, 77% against 96%.

label: chaB
facts:
WINDOW: the chaB window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor chaB, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,477 to 2,556 from dnaA. Read in 535 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying chaB once); 42,800 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 91% of genes, 0.48 bits on average (perplexity 1.6 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 30,006 calls, named 98%, 0.19 bits; shell 12,122 calls, named 79%, 1.03 bits; cloud 672 calls, named 27%, 3.74 bits. Outside an RGP 32,858 calls, named 96%, 0.25 bits; inside an RGP 9,942 calls, named 77%, 1.24 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 38 fork, 41 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.24 against 0.25 bits) and names fewer genes (77% against 96%); 9,942 of the 42,800 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 54 (ariR) 1.10 bits, RGP 70%; column 53 (ymgC) 1.09 bits, RGP 70%; column 52 (pdeG) 1.07 bits, RGP 65%. The 13 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 86%, 0.81 bits on average; the other 67 columns: named 93%, 0.42 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 1-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 0-81%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: chaB. named 98%; 0.10 bits.
2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 0-81%. named 78-100% (mean 91%), fewest named at column 53, named 78%; most hesitant at column 54, 1.10 bits.
